aiDescription.summary: The resolution orders the Secretary of State, within 30 days, to submit a 502B(c) statement on Uzbekistan’s human‑rights practices prepared with DRL and the State Department Legal Adviser. It requires information on alleged abuses (arbitrary detention, torture, disappearances, trafficking), treatment of non‑Uzbek nationals removed to Uzbekistan, U.S. actions and assessments (including security assistance, assurances, individuals sent in 2025–26), and summaries of 2025–26 U.S.–Uzbek meetings.

description.text: A resolution requesting information on the Republic of Uzbekistan's human rights practices pursuant to section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

impact.summary: The resolution directs the Secretary of State, with the State Department DRL office and Legal Adviser, to deliver a 502B report on Uzbekistan to the Senate Foreign Relations and House Foreign Affairs Committees within 30 days. The report must list alleged Uzbek abuses, U.S. security‑assistance risks, people the U.S. sent in 2025–2026, related assurances, and U.S. agencies' actions on removals.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (text: CR S960-961)
